about_the_game:
Survive endless waves of darkness as a divine warrior blessed with holy powers. Level up, unlock devastating spells, and face increasingly powerful demonic hordes. Will you ascend to face the ultimate evil?

✨ Three Distinct Game Modes

  • Survival Mode - Test your skills in endless waves

  • Progression Mode - Journey through 5 increasingly difficult tiers

  • Ascended Mode - Face the ultimate challenge after completing Progression

⚔️ Dynamic Spell System

  • Holy Strike - Divine projectile that pierces through enemies

  • Divine Shield - Protective barrier with devastating counterattack

  • Metatron's Pulse - Screen-clearing holy explosion

🏆 20+ Steam Achievements

  • Track your progress with diverse challenges

  • Unlock achievements for kills, bosses, survival time, and special conditions

📊 Steam Leaderboards

  • Compete globally in Survival and Progression modes

  • Compare scores with friends

  • Climb the ranks to prove your divine might

💾 Steam Cloud Saves

  • Your progress syncs across devices

  • Meta-progression in Progression Mode keeps your stats on death

  • Never lose your hard-earned upgrades

🎮 Roguelike Progression

  • Level up and choose stat upgrades

  • Unlock and upgrade powerful spells

  • Face 19 different enemy types

  • Challenge epic boss encounters

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
